points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable CMake build passed in a network-disabled, resource-limited scratch container with configured external roots; no CFD run was repeated.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:21,33 accepts --restart but never reads it; :101–104 always initializes freestream. Required case/output flags exist; unknown flags are silently ignored.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: CMake builds separate mesh, numerical kernels, solver and output files; solver.cpp combines most execution paths and interfaces are explicitly 2-D.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: CMake builds submitted solver with MPI/CGNS/METIS; no direct existing CFD solver call identified. No comprehensive external source-similarity or licensing audit.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case configuration supplies mesh and physics; no filename-only special case identified. Unseen arbitrary meshes were not exercised.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:76–107 retains a full GlobalMesh per rank throughout solving, prohibited by TASK.md:227. numerics.cpp:5–62 sets ghost gradients to zero and solver.cpp:62–80 uses them in face fluxes; rank-study differences remain nontrivial.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp checks finite steady residuals and inadmissible states, but transient status is unconditional at :656; --restart is unused. Initial physics states remain local/ghost.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: All eight submitted packages and report pass the structural validator; no independent numerical test suite or refinement study was found in the committed solver tree.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source units build cleanly, but dead Roe scratch expressions and incorrect restart/replication claims reduce maintainability; raw results and PDF were curated from the tip.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
